pages.text: $(bold)Where a thing lives sets its tier.$()$(br2)A boss or structure gets the tier of the dimension it generates in, however hard it is: $(bold)location-based tiering$().$(li)$(t1)T1$(): the Overworld$(li)$(t2)T2$(): Twilight Forest, Blue Skies$(li)$(t3)T3$(): Nether and deep dimensions$(li)$(t4)T4$(): the Aether, the End and endgame dimensions

$(bold)Two big departures from vanilla:$()$(br2)The $(bold)Nether is Tier 3$() content and the $(bold)End is Tier 4$() content.$(br2)Both are far deadlier here than in vanilla. The Nether stays sealed until you reach Tier 3: a portal won't ignite before then. The End has its own Tier 4 key (see Reaching the End).

$(bold)Tier 2 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)Twilight Forest$(): dense, dark and full of ambushes, with bosses guarding progression. Its portal (a flower-ringed pool) is lit with a $(bold)Codex Token I$(); stepping through needs Tier 2.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies$() (Everbright and Everdawn): elemental combat. Its mobs deal elemental damage that bypasses standard armor.

$(bold)Tier 3 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)The Undergarden$(): toxic attrition from constant poison. Survival builds matter.$(br2)$(bold)Deeper and Darker$(): horror survival and sculk mechanics. Noise draws mobs; stealth pays.$(br2)$(bold)The Nether$(): relentless. Everything is always aggro and Piglins hunt in packs.$(br2)$(bold)The Abyss: The Other Side$(), optional at Tier 3.

$(bold)Tier 4 Dimensions$()$(br2)$(bold)The Aether$(): aerial warfare on floating islands, Deep Aether's biomes among them. The air is thin up high, the mobs are fast and a fall is lethal. Ranged builds shine here.$(br2)$(bold)The End$(): three zones that escalate from the Outer Islands to the Deep End and End Cities, then the Dragon's Domain. The End is designed to kill you. $(italic)Prepare accordingly.$()

pages.title: Reaching the End
pages.text: The vanilla stronghold and portal still apply: Eyes of Ender (a Tier 4 item here) lead you to the portal.$(br2)$(italic)Planned, not in the game yet:$() an $(bold)End Compass$() crafted from the $(bold)Aether$()'s materials, pointing to an $(bold)End Bastion$().$(br2)$(bold)The finale:$() defeating the $(t4)Ender Dragon$(). The Ad Astra planets don't wait for it: they are Tier 4 dimensions, reached by rocket.
